body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and suburban directory, 1870. 931 pages.
State Library Victoria has digitised this directory, and you can read it online.

The 1870 directory has its own Carlton section, under North Melbourne (pp. 73–103), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension between Victoria-street east and Reilly-street, as far east as Nicholson-street. It lists each street house by house, side by side, with the cross streets in order. Rathdowne-street is stored as Rathdown Street to match the later years. A few residents printed under an unnamed right-of-way are kept with the street it runs off, with a note.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street, and only the listings inside it are kept here.
